lines.zh: 我踩着黑色的草走过去
lines.en: I walk over dark grass.
My horns are deep blue.

lines.zh: 树林遮着，我的影子更暗
lines.en: In the trees my shadow is darker.
I press through the brush step by step.
My head rides low between my shoulders.
I walk along the forest edge.
Leaf litter crunches beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，鼻息在冷空气里
lines.en: I lift my head; my breath fogs the cold air.
I'm quicker than my bulk suggests.
I go around a fallen trunk.
My tail sweeps dead branches aside.

lines.zh: 风从林子里出来，带着凉
lines.en: Wind comes out of the wood, cold.
I tilt my head and listen.
Then I keep walking on.
I stand at the edge of the dark forest.

lines.zh: 深蓝的鳞在阴影里更暗
lines.en: My dark blue scales deepen in shadow.
I linger near my anchor.

lines.zh: 我这只角，是病毒型长的。
lines.en: This horn grew in the virus strain.
My breathing is slow and deep.

lines.zh: 我把头转向更暗的地方
lines.en: I turn my head toward darker ground.
My teeth won't fit inside my jaw.
I lift a foreclaw, then set it down.

lines.zh: 这一片针叶林很适合藏身
lines.en: This conifer wood hides things well.
I don't move, but I wait.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在树影里发亮
lines.en: My eyes shine in the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转向声音那边
lines.en: I turn my ears toward the sound

lines.zh: 我把身子的重心沉下去
lines.en: I sink my weight downward.
It's gone quiet again.
I watch you from the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 你的颜色在林子里很显眼
lines.en: Your colours stand out in this wood.
My horns point your way.

lines.zh: 我没有走近，也没有走开
lines.en: I neither approach nor leave.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后慢慢摆
lines.en: My tail sways slowly behind me.
Are you looking at my horns?
They're heavier than they look.
I tilt my head; my teeth show.
You gave half a step. Wise.
I have a use for this shadow.

lines.zh: 你再往前一步就不一样了
lines.en: One more step from you changes things.
I step out a little way.
So you can see me better.
Though maybe clearer isn't better.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在林子里有回音
lines.en: My breathing echoes in the wood.
You can hear this sound.
A deep mark is left on my blue scales
A score across my scales.
That made me duck my head.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，林子里有回声
lines.en: I roar; the wood returns it.

lines.zh: 血在暗处看起来是黑的
lines.en: In the dim light my blood looks black.
Dark blood drips onto the fallen leaves

lines.zh: 枯枝在我脚下断成两截
lines.en: A branch snaps in two under me.
You fight harder than you look.
Then I'll stop holding back.
Then I bite you once more.
I can smell meat.
You hold it up, hand a little unsteady.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等你自己放下
lines.en: No rush. I'll wait for you to set it down.
There is always too little meat in these woods
Meat is scarce in the dark forest.
I shift a step toward the thing.
You place it on a tree root.
Then you stepped back. Good.
I lower my head and take it away.
Eating hasn't made me gentler.
But I won't drive you off.
Just this once. Agreed.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的侧腹，像撞墙
lines.en: You hit my flank like a wall.
My scales barely shift.
You back off, steps disordered.
That made my tail flick.

lines.zh: 我的低吼在林子间回响
lines.en: My growl rolls between the trees.
I shift half a step from the tree.
Two dead branches snap underfoot.
My horn rakes across your shoulder plate

lines.zh: 那是我最不喜欢被碰的
lines.en: Those are what I least like touched.
Try again and don't blame me.
We keep to small groups in the dark wood.
The wood is thick. Hard to find each other.
So I walk on your outer side.

lines.zh: 我的锚点在两块石头之间
lines.en: My anchor is between two stones.
Night's cold. Come nearer to me.
My scales aren't warm, but they block wind.

lines.zh: 我们不叫，声音会引来东西
lines.en: We don't call. Noise draws things.

lines.zh: 有东西来，我会先站起来
lines.en: If something comes, I stand first.
You sleep. I'm awake.
We don't move before dawn.
I lower my head and take it.
This won't soften.
I spit it out and step on it.
What you dropped, I've taken.
Two claw nudges, and it won't budge.
I don't like the taste of metal.
Useful things I carry in my jaws.
Too heavy. I set it down.
I push it under the roots.
I might remember it later.
You snapped a dead branch.

lines.zh: 我听见了，所以找到了你
lines.en: I heard it, so I found you.
I lower my head and move in.
Teeth first, horns after.
The wood is thick. You can't run well.
Every branch you break, I remember
You go round a tree; so do I.
My breathing is right behind you.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林，我闭眼也认路
lines.en: I know this pine forest even with my eyes shut
You've backed to the fallen log.
That spot suits me perfectly.
I'm striking right now.
I follow you among the trees.
You change course; I change too.
My scales rasp the bark.
Soft. You may not hear it.

lines.zh: 我放慢呼吸，你却没停下
lines.en: I slow my breathing and you still do not stop
I wait for a turn.

lines.zh: 转弯的时候你看不到我
lines.en: At a turn you won't see me.

lines.zh: 前面是空地，你出去就露了
lines.en: Open ground ahead. You'll be exposed.
I stop behind a tree.
Waiting for you to walk past.
It has to be this moment.
I step out from behind the tree.
I slam in from the side.
My teeth clamp your upper arm.
This drives you into the brush.
My horns wrench your shield aside.
You're pinned against a tree.

lines.zh: 树皮被我的爪子刮掉一层
lines.en: My claws strip bark from the trunk.
Another bite, and it misses.
But you fell back; I press in.
My breathing is at your ear.
The wood swallows the sound.
One more will do it.
You're about to give way.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林深处走出来
lines.en: I come out of the dark forest's depths.
Dark blue horns break the shadow first.
Four of us arrived.

lines.zh: 我从树影里迈出第一步
lines.en: I take my first step out of the tree shadow
I take my place by the anchor.
The air in this wood is cold.
My breath is visible.
I turn my head slowly, finding a heading.
The tree shadow covers half of me.
This works nicely.
Fresh marks on the ground.
Not deep. Just made.
I head along them.
Not quick, but unswerving.
The fire darkens my scales.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上的枯枝堆里
lines.en: I crash into a heap of dead branches.

lines.zh: 水一没过头，我只能猛挣
lines.en: Water closes over me; I can only thrash.
The blast drives me into a trunk.
An arrow sticks in the side of my neck.
That light came through my scales.
Too starved even to roar.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片林子，我僵住
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole wood and I freeze.
No trees. No ground.
